title: Python execution and values
concepts: variables, strings, integers, expressions, terminal and editor
build: Change the day-one order quantity, predict the total, run the seed and save the result
acceptance: A changed input produces the predicted integer total; explain why money uses paise

title: Decisions and repetition
concepts: booleans, branches, loops, lists and dictionaries
build: Process a small in-memory order list and separate invalid quantities
acceptance: Zero and negative quantities follow a deliberate rule; all rows are accounted for

title: Functions and debugging
concepts: parameters, return values, scope, tracebacks and assertions
build: Extract order validation from reporting and diagnose a deliberately wrong comparison
acceptance: A new invalid input fails before the repair and follows the intended rule afterwards

title: Files and first project release
concepts: paths, text encoding, JSON, CSV, Git and README
build: Load synthetic orders from a file and save accepted and rejected counts
acceptance: A clean local checkout reproduces the report; malformed input has an explicit failure

title: Maintainable Python
concepts: modules, packages, type hints, dataclasses and exceptions
build: Separate parsing, validation, aggregation and command-line concerns
acceptance: Importing a module performs no data writes; errors preserve useful context

title: Persistent data foundation
concepts: SQL, keys, constraints, transactions and parameterized queries
build: Persist source records and run metadata with unique source-record identifiers
acceptance: Rerunning an identical input does not inflate accepted totals

title: Trustworthy transformations
concepts: decimal arithmetic, currency, time zones, joins and deterministic functions
build: Build daily sales and cancellation summaries from immutable synthetic input
acceptance: Hand-computed fixture totals match; a join cannot silently multiply orders

title: Test and design the first user journey
concepts: unit tests, integration tests, fixtures and interface sketches
build: Test boundaries and sketch source registration, run inspection and report evidence
acceptance: A learner explains one test that catches a real regression and demos input-to-report

title: Catalogue API
concepts: HTTP methods, validation, schemas, errors and dependency injection
build: Build FastAPI source registration and run lookup with a generated API description
acceptance: Valid and invalid requests have stable documented responses

title: First microservices boundary
concepts: processes, network failure, timeouts and service ownership
build: Run catalogue and ingestion separately; each owns its data and credentials
acceptance: Stopping ingestion leaves catalogue reads responsive with truthful run state

title: Durable run requests
concepts: job identifiers, idempotency keys, persistence and polling
build: Store a run request before execution and return a status resource
acceptance: A client retry refers to the same intended run and cannot enqueue uncontrolled duplicates

title: C parsing lab
concepts: compilation, integer bounds, arrays, pointers and file errors
build: Parse a bounded synthetic record in a C lab and compare with the Python contract
acceptance: Malformed and oversized records fail safely; compiler diagnostics are investigated

title: Validation and quarantine
concepts: schema, nulls, uniqueness, ranges and reason codes
build: Add a quality component with versioned rules and a reviewable quarantine
acceptance: Every rejected row has source identity and a precise rule result

title: Lineage and reproducibility
concepts: dataset, job, run, artifact version and provenance
build: Record source-to-output links and code/rule versions for each report
acceptance: Trace a report value to source rows and reproduce the same result

title: Freshness and reconciliation
concepts: event time, ingestion time, freshness, completeness and reconciliation
build: Distinguish a healthy empty feed from a missing or late feed
acceptance: Injected staleness and missing records are detected without corrupting a valid empty day

title: C resource discipline
concepts: allocation, lifetime, bounds checking and memory diagnostics
build: Extend the parsing lab with bounded allocation and systematic cleanup
acceptance: Representative malformed input runs show no diagnosed leaks or out-of-bounds access

title: Workflow state machine
concepts: states, legal transitions, attempts, leases and cancellation
build: Model queued, running, succeeded, failed and cancelled attempts
acceptance: Illegal transitions fail and cancellation has a documented race policy

title: SQL ownership and migrations
concepts: indexes, isolation, migrations, locking and query plans
build: Give each service private database access and version its schema
acceptance: No service reads another service table directly; upgrade a seeded database safely

title: Java integration audit
concepts: classes, interfaces, collections, exceptions, JDBC and testing
build: After college instruction, write a read-only inventory adapter implementing a contract
acceptance: A changed inventory fixture is processed independently with safe query parameters

title: C++ processing lab
concepts: references, const, value semantics, RAII and containers
build: Build a bounded C++ batch summary over the same synthetic records
acceptance: Resources release on failure; compare accuracy and trade-offs with Python

title: Broker and backpressure
concepts: queues, acknowledgements, redelivery, bounded concurrency and retries
build: Move run execution to a durable broker with capped attempts and dead-letter handling
acceptance: A failed worker triggers bounded redelivery without unbounded queue growth

title: Outbox and inbox
concepts: local transactions, outbox relay, consumer deduplication and ordering
build: Commit state plus an outbox event together and deduplicate consumer effects
acceptance: Crashes before publish and after commit do not lose accepted work or double-apply effects

title: Workflow dependencies
concepts: directed acyclic graphs, cycle detection, partitions and backfills
build: Execute a small ingest-validate-transform workflow with partition-aware replay
acceptance: Cycles are rejected and replay updates only the intended partition

title: Security foundation
concepts: identity, authorization, least privilege, secrets and threat modelling
build: Integrate a maintained identity provider and enforce roles and tenant scope in services
acceptance: Tenant A cannot enumerate, fetch or modify tenant B objects using guessed identifiers

title: Connector contract
concepts: configuration schemas, capabilities, cursor checkpoints and versioning
build: Define discover, test-connection and read-batch operations with a connector test suite
acceptance: CSV, database and HTTP fixtures follow one result and error contract

title: HTTP connector reliability
concepts: pagination, rate limits, timeouts, credentials and schema drift
build: Read a synthetic support API with checkpoint resume and bounded page handling
acceptance: A repeated page, expired cursor and response schema change produce deliberate outcomes

title: Rust validator lab
concepts: ownership, borrowing, enums, Result, traits and property tests
build: Write a typed record validator and compare errors with the Python reference
acceptance: Changed invalid inputs return typed errors; integrate only with correctness and measured benefit

title: Programming and maths readiness
concepts: Python data handling, Java foundations, linear algebra, calculus and probability
build: Complete independent prerequisite checks using platform fixtures
acceptance: Explain train/test separation, a gradient and conditional probability before advanced ML

title: Exploratory data analysis
concepts: dataframes, missingness, distributions, sampling and descriptive statistics
build: Investigate cancellations by source, product and time without overstating causes
acceptance: The report distinguishes observations, hypotheses and missing evidence

title: Classical models
concepts: linear/logistic regression, trees, ensembles, clustering and dimensionality reduction
build: Compare appropriate models on a frozen cancellation or anomaly task
acceptance: Training transformations fit only training data; metrics include class imbalance effects

title: Forecasting and anomaly evaluation
concepts: time splits, seasonal baselines, residuals, precision and recall
build: Compare a demand forecast with a seasonal naive baseline and assess alert usefulness
acceptance: Temporal holdout and slice metrics are reproducible; a worse model is not promoted

title: Data product evidence
concepts: metric definitions, dataset versions, model cards and uncertainty
build: Publish versioned deterministic insights plus an experimental ML result
acceptance: Every output identifies its input version and limitations; deterministic reports work without ML

title: Containers and local deployment
concepts: Linux processes, image builds, networking, volumes and health checks
build: Package implemented services and dependencies in a reproducible local composition
acceptance: A fresh machine can start the documented subset and preserve expected data across restart

title: Continuous integration
concepts: dependency locks, contract tests, migration checks, artifact digests and supply chain
build: Build and verify service artifacts on changes with minimal workflow permissions
acceptance: A contract-breaking change blocks release and the tested artifact is the deployed artifact

title: Infrastructure as code
concepts: cloud primitives, Terraform state, plans, drift and teardown
build: Provision a small isolated staging environment with budget ownership and documented teardown
acceptance: Recreate the environment without manual hidden settings and record its resource inventory

title: Kubernetes lab
concepts: deployments, services, probes, requests, limits and rolling updates
build: Operate one existing service in a bounded cluster lab after container readiness
acceptance: Diagnose an unhealthy deployment and roll it back; adopt for pilot only if operations justify it

title: Go collection agent
concepts: packages, interfaces, goroutines, channels, contexts and cancellation
build: Build an optional outbound-only collector with bounded concurrency and buffered retry
acceptance: Offline recovery drains its bounded spool without duplicates; cancellation stops work

title: Customer connector lifecycle
concepts: installation, scoped credentials, upgrade, revocation and removal
build: Package one reviewed connector with onboarding and uninstall instructions
acceptance: Revoked access stops collection; an upgrade preserves checkpoints; removal leaves no active credential

title: End-to-end observability
concepts: structured logs, metrics, traces, correlation and cardinality
build: Trace API request, queued task, validation and output across services
acceptance: Investigate an injected failure using one run identifier without logging record contents

title: Data reliability objectives
concepts: SLIs, SLOs, freshness, alerting and error budgets
build: Define user-relevant service and data objectives with an alert response guide
acceptance: A stale feed alerts the correct owner; API health does not hide stale data

title: Performance and resilience
concepts: profiling, capacity, load testing, queue lag and failure injection
build: Measure bottlenecks and test slow consumers, restarts and dependency outages
acceptance: Published p95, throughput and recovery results name hardware and exact workload

title: Recovery and data lifecycle
concepts: backups, restore, retention, deletion and reconciliation
build: Restore service data and artifacts into an isolated environment and reconcile runs
acceptance: Measured recovery meets proposed RPO/RTO; deletion and retention are tested across derived data

title: Model serving and MLOps
concepts: model registry, training lineage, drift, champion/challenger and rollback
build: Version and serve a model behind an evaluated service contract
acceptance: A bad candidate rolls back and unavailable serving falls back to deterministic reporting

title: Deep learning track
concepts: tensors, autograd, backpropagation, optimization and regularization
build: Train a small PyTorch model on a justified platform task and compare with classical methods
acceptance: Explain a gradient, reproduce a run and reject added complexity without measured benefit

title: Retrieval and text engineering
concepts: tokenization, embeddings, indexing, retrieval and access filtering
build: Retrieve only authorized incident notes and metric definitions for an investigation
acceptance: Cross-tenant documents never enter retrieval context; source links resolve

title: LLM explanations
concepts: structured output, citations, uncertainty, abstention and prompt injection
build: Generate explanations from computed facts and retrieved evidence
acceptance: Unsupported claims trigger abstention or review; untrusted text cannot authorize actions

title: AI evaluation and efficiency
concepts: frozen evaluation sets, caching, token budgets, latency and cost
build: Evaluate groundedness, factual consistency, access filtering and usefulness
acceptance: Publish error examples and per-investigation cost; deterministic alternatives remain available

title: Advanced AI breadth
concepts: transformers, time-series models, NLP, computer vision and reinforcement learning
build: Use bounded offline experiments relevant to ticket text or pipeline scheduling
acceptance: Explain applicability and failure modes; keep CV/RL elective unless product evidence justifies them

title: Major project proposal
concepts: problem formulation, literature comparison, novelty and evaluation design
build: Confirm supervisor rubric and deadlines; define the research and engineering contribution
acceptance: Approved scope names testable questions and maps report sections to evidence

title: Pilot scope and usability design
concepts: personas, task flows, onboarding, accessibility and information architecture
build: Test sketches for source setup, failed-run investigation and insight-to-source navigation
acceptance: Representative users can explain the next action from each screen

title: Launch threat and operations review
concepts: risk review, support ownership, security verification and incident response
build: Review applicable security requirements and rehearse one complete incident
acceptance: Each launch gate has an owner and procedure; unresolved critical risks block customer use

title: Elective consolidation
concepts: Haskell pure functions, types, higher-order functions and folds
build: Spend at most six hours comparing pure transformations with Python pipeline functions
acceptance: Explain the concept and one trade-off; move unused time to prerequisite repair

title: JavaScript and TypeScript gate
concepts: modules, promises, types, browser HTTP and state
build: Complete browser-language exercises against stable catalogue and run APIs
acceptance: Handle failed and cancelled requests without stale or misleading results

title: React product foundation
concepts: components, state, routing, forms and accessibility
build: Build source setup, run history and quality summary views
acceptance: Keyboard-only onboarding succeeds and field errors identify a useful correction

title: Interactive investigation
concepts: graph views, drill-down, comparisons, timelines and chart semantics
build: Build pipeline inspection, run comparison and insight-to-source navigation
acceptance: A chart point resolves to supporting records and a failed node resolves to a diagnostic

title: Frontend quality and integration
concepts: component tests, end-to-end tests, loading/empty/error states and budgets
build: Exercise the complete retailer journey with auth and real staging service contracts
acceptance: Refresh, slow network and expired sessions preserve truthful state and recoverable navigation

title: Feature freeze and release validation
concepts: compatibility, migrations, security fixes and regression selection
build: Freeze candidate scope and run all applicable launch gate procedures
acceptance: All mandatory gates have dated evidence for the exact release candidate

title: Pilot and operational rehearsal
concepts: onboarding, support, alert response, rollback and cost review
build: Onboard an approved pilot environment and rehearse failure, restore and rollback
acceptance: A second person follows the runbook without undocumented intervention

title: Experiments and report
concepts: baselines, ablations, reproducibility, limitations and technical writing
build: Finish reliability, performance, ML and usability experiments and write the report
acceptance: Each claimed result links to a reproducible experiment and acknowledges limitations

title: Submission and viva preparation
concepts: demonstration, architecture defence, test interpretation and handover
build: Rehearse a clean-environment demo and answer why each service and language exists
acceptance: Candidate matches the actual college rubric and the confirmed submission deadline

title: Final acceptance
concepts: release review, outstanding defects and go/no-go decision
build: Resolve mandatory gate failures and record the release decision
acceptance: Named reviewer accepts the exact version; unpassed gates remain visible

title: Controlled launch
concepts: staged rollout, smoke tests, rollback triggers and user communication
build: Launch only the approved pilot scope and monitor agreed objectives
acceptance: Rollout can stop safely; customer-facing claims match measured behaviour

title: Maintenance and ownership
concepts: patching, restore cadence, incident review, cost control and support
build: Hand over operating ownership with a recurring maintenance calendar
acceptance: A new maintainer handles one upgrade and recovery rehearsal

title: Portfolio and next learning plan
concepts: architecture explanation, evidence curation and reflective review
build: Prepare a sanitized project narrative, demo and next-term improvement backlog
acceptance: Explain trade-offs and measured outcomes without exposing customer data
